text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Here it is: the Kobe Shimbun Hai...
Today, that Kris S girl is in the race too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for a graded race makes me
a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle looks a bit nervous.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as an ordinary Umamusume,
she should have had more than enough strength
to push through this hurdle.
choice_data_list: It's not really something to get so worked up over...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, when you put a goal into words like that,
it kinda adds pressure. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. By any chance,
could it possibly be~...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you thinking, "If I get through this race,
I can take on Gimlet-chan and Kris S-chan in the Kikuka Sho~"?
choice_data_list: That part... is still undecided, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So you mean it depends on how the race turns out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I had considered it. But right now, I don't want to put unnecessary pressure on her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just let me focus on the Kobe Shimbun Hai right in front of me for now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, a friend of mine
gave me some shocking news!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The TV, the TV!
Please turn on the TV~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I frantically turned on the TV.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, hibernation. My fledgling legs grew scorching hot
from piercing through the mortal realm below...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to do but wait until it cools down.
Yes, wait for the Twilight of the Gods!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Due to my injury, I have to take a break from racing for a while...
It's true, Gimlet-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "What came next was the news of Tanino Gimlet taking a hiatus and withdrawing from the Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Gimlet-chan... She can kick away any trouble... I thought bad things would run away before they ever reached her. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is what happens when you try to be
the star of the Twinkle Series...
Even for a girl as great as Gimlet...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And yet, if someone like me,
who's still scared out of her mind, were to step in...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
is it really going to be all right...?
What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, but even so~... I'm worried about Gimlet-chan, and plus! Um, uhhh...
choice_data_list: Let's just focus on the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to avoid making Hishi Miracle overthink things,
as she isn't particularly dexterous or adaptable.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
I have to calm down, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan... did you hear?
About Gimlet-chan.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, I wonder what Kris S-chan thinks...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
She taught me a lot.
I've inherited things from her. But—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: My mission remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I need only determine what must be done.
—After the race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan...
What do you mean by assessing...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "For Hishi Miracle, this race would test all the effort she'd put in up to now. Meanwhile—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Symboli Kris S also had
something special she was keeping close to her chest.
